title: Thread Types FAQ Content Repair

original_defect.as_reported_by_d1_6: Five visible FAQ answers each paired with the wrong question; a clean one-position rotation.
original_defect.as_confirmed_by_d1_6r_review: Not a content corruption. Each visible answer correctly answers its own visible question. The actual pattern is that FAQPage schema and the visible FAQ contain the same 5 underlying questions in a different order (schema's 'What is a thread type?' corresponds to visible's differently-worded final question 'What is a thread type in one sentence?'). D1.6's original finding resulted from comparing schema and visible arrays by position rather than by matching question text, which made two independently-ordered but individually-correct lists appear scrambled.
